timeline.title: A royal panchayat
timeline.body: Constituted under the Kochi state, with C. Karunakaran Nair at its head.
timeline.bodyMl: കൊച്ചി രാജ്യത്തിന് കീഴിൽ സി. കരുണാകരൻ നായരുടെ നേതൃത്വത്തിൽ രൂപീകൃതമായി.

timeline.title: The first elected president
timeline.body: Aachattil Narayanankutty Menon took office in the first election after independence.
timeline.bodyMl: സ്വാതന്ത്ര്യാനന്തരമുള്ള ആദ്യ തിരഞ്ഞെടുപ്പിൽ ആചാട്ടിൽ നാരായണൻകുട്ടി മേനോൻ അധികാരമേറ്റു.

timeline.title: The present committee
timeline.body: President Sajitha Murali and Vice President Suresh C.C., with twenty-four elected members.
timeline.bodyMl: പ്രസിഡന്റ് സജിത മുരളി, വൈസ് പ്രസിഡന്റ് സുരേഷ് സി.സി., ഒപ്പം ഇരുപത്തിനാല് അംഗങ്ങൾ.

council.name: President — Sajitha Murali
council.body: Heads the elected committee and chairs its meetings. Term beginning 2025.

council.name: Vice President — Suresh C.C.
council.body: Deputises for the president and works with the standing committees.

council.name: The elected committee
council.body: Twenty-four members, elected by ward, meeting to approve the annual plan and budget.

council.name: Standing committees
council.body: Subject committees covering finance, development, welfare, health and public works. Membership to be added.

council.name: Ninety years of self-government
council.body: From the royal panchayat of 1110 ME to the present council — the full list of presidents since 1954 is being compiled.
